# Largest Even Number. When no even number can be made, the answer is the empty string "".

@example The last 2 is the fourth digit, so the two 1s after it can't be kept; every digit before it can.
"211211"
=> "2112"

@example There is no 2 for an even number to end on.
"11111"
=> ""

@example It already ends in 2, so keep everything. Keeping only the 2s would give 22, a far smaller number.
"12112"
=> "12112"

# The shortest inputs.
"1"
=> ""

"2"
=> "2"

# Two digits.
"21"
=> "2"

"12"
=> "12"

# Every digit is a 2: everything is kept.
"2222"
=> "2222"

# Keeping only the 2s would give 222, shorter and so smaller.
"21212"
=> "21212"

# Several 1s after the last 2, and 2s before it.
"1121211"
=> "11212"

# 25 digits: more than a 64-bit integer holds.
"1111111111111111111112111"
=> "1111111111111111111112"

# 100 digits and no 2.
"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
=> ""

# 100 digits ending in their only 2.
"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
=> "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111112"

# 100 digits: a 2 at the front, then 99 1s.
"2111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
=> "2"

# 100 digits whose last 2 is at index 59, followed by 40 1s.
"1121112111211121112111211121112111211121112111211121112111221111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
=> "112111211121112111211121112111211121112111211121112111211122"

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"121111122"
=> "121111122"

@gen 2 small
"1111111"
=> ""

@gen 3 small
"222122"
=> "222122"

@gen 4 small
"2112"
=> "2112"

@gen 5 small
"2111111111"
=> "2"

@gen 17 small
"111111121"
=> "11111112"

@gen 26 small
"1122211221"
=> "112221122"

# Full size: 100 digits with no 2, with 2s scattered, or with a single 2
# near the end.
@gen 2
"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
=> ""

@gen 3
"2111111112111111111111111211111111111121111211211112111111112111121211211111111111111111111112111121"
=> "211111111211111111111111121111111111112111121121111211111111211112121121111111111111111111111211112"

@gen 6
"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111121111111111"
=> "111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
